metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the macos-def:disabledservice_test is properly supported
metadata.description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the macos-def:disabledservice_test.

notes.note: It is important to note that the values used in this test definition are specific to a particular machine, and may not necessarily apply to your system. As a result, in order to have the definition return a result of 'true', you must either change these values to the ones found on your particular system, or you must configure your system to use these values.

criterion.comment: Test that the disabledservice_object is supported.

disabledservice_test.comment: Test that the disabledservice_object is supported with the disabledservice_var entity equal to some value.

disabledservice_object.comment: This object represents the singleton disabledservice_object.

disabledservice_state.comment: This disabledservice_state represents an disabledservice_item which has a disabledservice label with a value of 'com.apple.ftpd'.
disabledservice_state.label: com.apple.ftpd
